text: {"lessons":["After selling winners early, I later bought stocks again at different prices; I should avoid treating a realized gain as proof that selling was well timed.","Buying several positions at once used cash across the portfolio, so I should check diversification and risk before committing funds rather than deciding stock by stock alone.","I held through sizable monthly swings without trading; given that prices are unpredictable, I should distinguish deliberate patience from neglect by reviewing my plan periodically."]}
